shared_behavior_issue: GuideStepDescription adds a generic GuideStepHint and a generated reason to every objective tooltip. GuideDestinationPurpose/GuideVisibleReason also generates objective context for navigation. The Durotar catalogue has no zone-authored flavor fields that can remove this repetition. A Durotar-only data edit cannot fix it; coordinate a shared rendering/reason policy with the main developer.
proposed_shared_policy: Show the objective action once. Add a context line only for a meaningful decision such as an actual prerequisite, useful lower-level exception, unusual detour, danger or dungeon preparation. Suppress generic text that only says the target is needed for the quest or that work should be completed in the marked area.
